proof_delta_from_v1: The v1 proof used L=350 only to conclude that every live degree equals 50. Exact equality is unnecessary.
Because d=50 is the selected minimum live-variable degree, every nonpivot live variable has degree at least 50 for every admissible L in this family.
At most c=m-d=28 retained clauses contain a given nonpivot coordinate, hence that coordinate occurs in at least 50-28=22 pivot-parent tails regardless of L.

All other parts of the v1 proof depend only on r=6, c=28, p:q, the 637-clause cap threshold, clean-core sizes, ternary-support separation, and the three-coordinate two-mask separation lemma. None depends on L.
Therefore the contradiction P0<=7 versus P0>=9 applies to every admissible L with n=7,m=78,d=50 and p:q in the listed balanced range.
